title: N11 seller lead discovery
description: Discover sellers from N11 search, category, product, or store pages and enrich public store and business-registration fields.

campaignId.title: Aime campaign ID
campaignId.description: Optional Aime campaign identifier passed through to every Dataset row and OUTPUT record.

shardId.title: Aime shard ID
shardId.description: Optional Aime shard identifier passed through to every Dataset row and OUTPUT record.

crawlScope.title: Crawl scope
crawlScope.description: full_platform uses the versioned built-in public category manifest. custom uses searchQueries or startUrls.

maxCategoriesPerRun.title: Maximum categories per Run
maxCategoriesPerRun.description: Maximum unfinished manifest categories scheduled in one full-platform Run. Completed categories are skipped automatically.

accessMode.title: Network access mode
accessMode.description: Choose direct HTTP, Apify Residential Proxy, Bright Data Web Unlocker, or automatic fallback.

apifyProxyCountry.title: Apify Proxy country
apifyProxyCountry.description: Two-letter country code used by Apify Residential Proxy.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Custom-mode product, brand, or category phrases. Leave empty in full-platform mode.

startUrls.title: N11 URLs
startUrls.description: Custom-mode public search, category, product, or store URLs. Leave empty in full-platform mode.

maxPagesPerSource.title: Maximum pages per source
maxPagesPerSource.description: Number of consecutive pages handled by this shard for each source.

startPage.title: Explicit start page
startPage.description: Custom mode only: optional page override for a manually assigned shard. Full-platform mode always uses per-category checkpoints.

resumeFromCheckpoint.title: Resume from checkpoint
resumeFromCheckpoint.description: When startPage is unset, continue from the next unfinished page stored in dedupeStoreName.

maxProductsPerSource.title: Maximum products per source page
maxProductsPerSource.description: Maximum product links sampled from each search, category, or store page.

maxProductDetails.title: Maximum product detail pages
maxProductDetails.description: Maximum product pages inspected for seller and product evidence.

maxSellerCandidates.title: Maximum seller candidates
maxSellerCandidates.description: Maximum unique seller profiles inspected before qualification filters.

maxSellers.title: Maximum qualified sellers
maxSellers.description: Maximum qualified seller leads checkpointed to the Dataset.

minSellerRating.title: Minimum seller rating
minSellerRating.description: Minimum public N11 store score on the 0-10 scale.

minProductCount.title: Minimum store products
minProductCount.description: Only output stores whose public product count meets this threshold.

minSellerReviewCount.title: Minimum store reviews
minSellerReviewCount.description: Only output stores whose public feedback count meets this threshold.

sellerCities.title: Headquarter cities
sellerCities.description: Optional case-insensitive exact filter on public headquarter city, for example İstanbul or Ankara.

sellerBadges.title: Seller badges
sellerBadges.description: Optional exact filter on public badges such as Başarılı Mağaza, Hızlı Gönderim, or Yetkili Mağaza.

requireSellerProfile.title: Require store profile
requireSellerProfile.description: Exclude candidates when the public N11 store profile cannot be parsed.

maxRequestRetries.title: Maximum unlock retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Retries after a failed or blocked Web Unlocker request.

navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout seconds
navigationTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum duration of each Web Unlocker request.

dedupeMode.title: Cross-run deduplication
dedupeMode.description: Emit all qualified rows, only new sellers, or new and changed sellers.

dedupeStoreName.title: Persistent state store
dedupeStoreName.description: Named Key-Value Store shared across Runs. Leave unset for the scope-specific default; use a distinct name per campaign for isolation.
